The '''Tenth Pius Dea Crusade''', also known as the '''Crusade of the Wilds''', was one of the conflicts known as the [[Pius Dea Crusades]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], under the control of the [[Pius Dea]] religious group, initiated a campaign against various [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and suspected alien sympathizers.
